name: What factors influence the cost of molding repair?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of molding repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair molding depends on whether it requires surface patching or full board replacement, the trim material, and the extent of finishing work. Patching minor gouges on a single wall is generally an economical handyman service, while replacing ornate crown molding or repairing multiple rooms increases labor. Key pricing factors include custom profile milling, height accessibility for crown trim, and whether the repair requires adjacent drywall patching, caulking, and multi-coat interior painting to match surrounding walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the damage severity, molding type, custom milling requirements, and whether the scope includes drywall patching, caulking, and finish painting.
